csv_project_name: AE for Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel Guest Room Remodel
csv_scope_of_work: The Vancouver Downtown Redevelopment Authority (DRA) is seeking statements of qualifications from architecture and engineering (A&E) firms to provide professional design, project management, and construction management services for the remodel of two guest rooms at the Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel. The DRA is soliciting proposals from architecture and engineering (A&E) firms to provide professional design, project management, and construction management services for the remodel of two (2) guest rooms at the Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel. This project is time sensitive in that following approval of the design and completion of the two prototype rooms, the DRA anticipates progressing forward to a full renovation of all hotel guest rooms. The remodel of the two (2) guest rooms will serve as a full-scale prototype for the future renovation of the remaining hotel guest rooms (approximately 224 rooms). As such, the selected consultant shall approach the design, documentation, and construction of the prototype rooms with a high level of rigor, coordination, and replicability across a large inventory of guest rooms with varying configuration. This shall include: Methodology for standardizing design elements while allowing for necessary adjustments across different room layouts and sizes Approach to documenting design intent to ensure consistency during future phased renovations Strategy for maintaining continuity of materials, finishes, and aesthetic standards across all renovated rooms Experience with prototype-based design in hospitality or similar large-scale renovation programs Ability to support future phases of renovation, including design updates, field adjustments, and coordination with ongoing construction activities Following completion of the two (2) prototype rooms, the Authority will evaluate the partnership (project management capabilities, quality of design, construction capabilities, replicability of the prototype rooms, and cost), and if deemed successful, the DRA anticipates utilizing the selected consultant for the renovation phases of the remaining 224 rooms.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: A&E Services for Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel Guest Room Remodel
short_description: Design and prototype renovation of two hotel rooms for a larger guest room program.
project_location: Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel, Vancouver, Washington, USA
project_scope: Remodel of two prototype guest rooms at the Hilton Vancouver Washington Hotel, intended as full-scale prototypes for a future phased renovation of approximately 224 remaining guest rooms. Scope emphasizes standardized design elements adaptable to varying room layouts and sizes, documentation of design intent for replicability, continuity of materials and finishes, and support for future renovation phases including design updates, field adjustments, and coordination during ongoing construction.
services: Architecture and engineering services including professional design, project management, construction management, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Hotel interior renovation with limited structural ambition; not a typical sbp core project.
- Focus is primarily architecture, interiors, project management, and prototype room replication.
- No notable long-span, bridge, roof, facade, stadium, or special structural component described.
- Structural engineering is listed, but only as part of a broad A&E team for guest room remodels.
- Potential later rollout to 224 rooms increases size, but remains a standard hospitality refurbishment.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender documents. Known scope: two prototype guest rooms now, with possible later renovation of approximately 224 additional rooms if the prototype phase is successful. This suggests a larger future hospitality refurbishment program, but no reliable USD construction cost can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is explicitly stated in the tender documents. The current procurement covers A&E design, project management, and construction management for two prototype rooms, with a possible extension to approximately 224 rooms, but there is insufficient information for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Firms should demonstrate experience with prototype-based design in hospitality or similar large-scale renovation programs, including standardization across varying room configurations, documentation for replicability, continuity of materials and finishes, and ability to support future phased renovations with design updates, field adjustments, and construction coordination.
award_criteria: The authority will evaluate project management capabilities, quality of design, construction capabilities, replicability of the prototype rooms, and cost. Exact weighting is not stated.

notes: Project number: DRA1-26. Questions deadline: 6/8/2026 04:00 PM PDT. Submission via Bonfire portal. The selected consultant may be retained for future renovation phases if the prototype rooms are successful.
